cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

mechanism: A encourages a pupil to assert its birthday wishes while increasingly angry at the cost its own lesson produces.
confusable: Help must persist through anger; A should not merely punish the pupil or withdraw its encouragement.
comparison: Physical cleanup aid versus paying for an assertive choice A encouraged.
seedUse: Use D21 seaside lunch/two deposits; S05 self-advocacy lessons make A responsible for encouraging the costly preference.
